name: Information Technology (IT) / Information Technology Enabled Services (ITeS) consulting
description: The course aims to provide students with an overview of what an IT consultant does in the industry, and how the IT consultant serves to enhance the digital effectiveness of its client organisations. The course will help students in developing problem identification, critical thinking, integrated thinking, solving abilities, communication skills and influencing skills. Synthesizing various management components and IT skills will prepare students to work in multi-cultural high performance teams working to solve client problems. By uncovering issues, framing problems and analyzing issues and presenting recommendations, students will be able learn the nuances of the consulting business. The mix of case-based problems and lectures will familiarize students with the real hard world of consulting, and with the life of a consultant.
